detail: Full summary: This repo's project-scope plugin pin was at 1.22.0 (pre-guard), silently shadowing user-scope 1.24.0 — which is why this machine's sessions never hit the every-session guard outage. When shipping plugin versions, verify BOTH scopes with `claude plugin list`.
